title: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2611.30280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. translated_title: 无需外部参考标注的LLM用户模拟器人格一致性评估
translated_abstract: 标准评估方法将LLM模拟的人格与外部真值（例如社区特质标注）进行对比，但当人格仅从简短的、面向任务的对话中推断出来时，这种参考是无法获得的。我们探讨如何在没有此类参考的情况下评估人格一致性，并提出了一种自我锚定的内部一致性诊断方法：人格描述自己一次并行动两次。李克特量表自我报告提供了软性的内部锚点；两个行为画像分别来自无需评审即可评分的受限场景选择，以及由LLM评判的开放式回答。一致性被定义为自我报告与每个行为画像之间的相关性，两者处于共享的BFI-2六维度空间中。该框架通过评估各种人格构建策略所引出的反应在多大程度上与其自我报告的特质保持一致，从而对这些策略进行比较。该方法在普通用户对话（WildChat和LMSYS）以及具有社区标注、文献记录完善的人格上进行了验证。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需外部参考标注的自我锚定内部一致性诊断方法，通过让LLM用户模拟器“自我报告一次、行为两次”，在共享的BFI-2六维度空间中量化自我报告与行为表现之间的相关性，从而评估和比较不同的人格构建策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic that evaluates persona consistency in LLM user simulators without external reference annotations, by having the persona self-report once and act twice, and measuring the correlation between self-report and behavioral profiles within a shared six-facet BFI-2 space.
